# Upstream

- Project: VulkaIris (Iris shaders on VulkanMod), https://github.com/Potatochip-p/vulkairis
- Base commit: `0e9d08f88aa0558f1368f28c0754afb18ec4b702` (2026-11-13)
- Licence: LGPL-3.0-only (upstream ships the LGPL-3.0 text as `LICENSE_VulkanMod`; kept unmodified here as `LICENSE`).
- Origin's build: `build/libs/vulkairis-origin-<version>.jar`, for Minecraft 1.21.1 with exactly
  Iris 1.8.14-beta.1 (Modrinth `bAo1Qhte`), VulkanMod 0.6.7 (`2eqroDKD`) and Fabric API 0.116.17.
  It is not a live module (not in `live-modules.json`).

## Origin's changes

### 2026-11-16 - boot fix (step 1)

- **Why upstream crashes at boot:** its nested `sodium-api.jar` has no `fabric.mod.json`, so Fabric Loader
  never puts it on the classpath. Iris then dies in `CrashReport` init with
  `NoClassDefFoundError: net/caffeinemc/mods/sodium/api/vertex/serializer/VertexSerializer`
  (confirmed by Origin's lavapipe CI probe, 2026-11-16).
- Removed every bundled third-party jar (`LIBS/`, including the full Sodium 0.8.12 jar, which is
  PolyForm Shield and may not be redistributed). Iris, VulkanMod and ModMenu now come from Modrinth's
  maven by version id.
- New subproject `sodium-compat/` (mod id `vulkairis_sodium_compat`): Origin's own stand-ins for the
  Sodium types Iris links against, written from Iris's call sites. No Sodium code. See
  `sodium-compat/README.md`.
- New subproject `sodium-provider/` (mod id `vulkairis_sodium_provider`): a code-free marker that
  `provides: ["sodium"]` at `0.8.0+vulkairis.compat.1`, so Iris's `sodium 0.8.x` dependency resolves.
  Kept separate so a launcher can drop just the marker.
- `VulkairisPreLaunch`: clears all of `mixins.iris.compat.sodium.json` (every entry targets a Sodium
  class that is deliberately absent) and adds `MixinFluidRendererImpl` to the stripped list.
- `fabric.mod.json`: Origin name, `LGPL-3.0-only`, depends on `vulkairis_sodium_compat`; nested jars
  are generated by Loom.
- Build: removed the Windows-only `org.gradle.java.home` / `gradle.user.home` pins (CI uses its own
  JDK 21); Gradle 9.5.1 + `fabric-loom-remap` 1.17-SNAPSHOT; unit tests run again (`gradlew test`),
  including `SodiumCompatCoverageTest`, which proves every Sodium member Iris links against exists in
  the stand-in and that no Iris mixin target does.

## 2026-11-16 composite/final (step 2)

Root causes (CI probe run 44002823904, MakeUp Ultra Fast 9.6 on): the pack never loaded at startup
("No shader pack active" with `enableShaders=true`), because upstream strips Iris's
`MixinRenderSystem`, the only caller of Iris's render-system init; and the old composite path ran from
`Renderer.endRenderPass` (every pass end, re-entrant) with a pipeline handle of 0, so nothing drew.

- `RenderSystemIrisInitMixin`: replays Iris's init sequence at `RenderSystem.initRenderer` RETURN.
- `GameRendererCompositeMixin` + `origin/composite/CompositeRunner`: the deferred + composite + final
  chain runs once per frame after `renderLevel`, with a re-entry guard, on real RGBA16F colortex
  MAIN/ALT images, through VulkanMod pipelines and render passes. The world image is copied (by a draw:
  swapchain images are not TRANSFER_SRC) into the scene buffer, the first draw buffer of
  `gbuffers_terrain`/`gbuffers_textured` (colortex0 when none), until gbuffers run on Vulkan.
- Multiple draw buffers: VulkanMod pipelines have one colour attachment, so output k > 0 draws with a
  one-output fragment variant (`FragOutputVariant`, `VulkanModProgramBridge.outputVariant`).
- `RendererMixin`: the old `onExecutePasses` call is removed.
- Unit tests: `CompositeRoutingTest` (Iris ping-pong + flip directives), `SamplerNamesTest`,
  `FragOutputVariantTest`.

## 2026-11-16 uniforms (step 3)
- Root cause: the injected `VulkairisUniformBlock` was filled with a fixed "OfGlobals" layout, not the
  block's reflected members, so every pack uniform read garbage or zero. Iris's `MixinLevelRenderer` and
  `MixinGameRenderer` (stripped) also never fed `CapturedRenderingState` or advanced the frame timer.
- `origin/uniforms/IrisUniformCapture`: a `DynamicUniformHolder` that records every uniform Iris's own
  `CommonUniforms` registers; `IrisUniformValues` evaluates them once per frame, plus the pack's custom
  uniforms (`uniform.*` in shaders.properties), and serves them by name.
- `VulkanModProgramBridge.uploadUniforms(gp, overrides)`: fills the block member by member (reflected
  std140 offsets, `Std140Writer`); other blocks keep the old payload.
- `LevelRendererIrisStateMixin` (renderLevel HEAD): gbufferModelView/Projection, tick delta, cloud time,
  world-time uniforms. The projection is converted from VulkanMod's forced 0..1 depth to GL's -1..1
  (`GlProjection`); stored depth needs no conversion (GL window depth == Vulkan NDC depth).
- `GameRendererCompositeMixin` HEAD: frameCounter / frameTimeCounter / real tick delta.
- `CompositeRunner`: Iris targets are now stored GL-style (row 0 = bottom, positive-height viewport),
  so texcoord, gl_FragCoord and depth reconstruction agree as on OpenGL; the world copy-in flips, the
  final pass renders into a GL-style scratch image and is copied out unflipped through VulkanMod's
  inverted main viewport. Post passes get Iris's quad matrices (identity model-view, 0..1 ortho, z = 0).

## 2026-11-16 programs link (step 3b)
Probe evidence (run 44005321098): every Iris program failed to link, so the post chain only copied.
- `VulkanBackendAdapter`: nothing ever called `init`, so the device was always null and every program
  logged "Vulkan device not ready" / "Cannot create VkShaderModule: VkDevice is not live". It now adopts
  VulkanMod's own `DeviceManager.vkDevice`. `IrisRenderSystemMixin` no longer ties the compute / SSBO /
  image-load-store capability flags to device liveness (they are recorded, not executed, on Vulkan).
- `ProgramTranslator`: varyings were left to Shaderc auto-mapping, which numbers each stage separately,
  so MakeUp's composite (different declaration order per stage) failed "stage interface mismatch".
  Vertex outs and fragment ins now get one location per name (same split-aware assignment the pipeline
  build uses, `ProgramTranslator.varyingLocations`). Translator version `phaseB-4-origin`.
- `PipelineCompatibilityValidator`: a fragment stage with no inputs (centerDepthSmooth) is valid.
- `VulkanModProgramBridge`: no session-wide link kill switch after 3 failures; each program fails alone.
Tests: `origin/VaryingLocationTest`; the translator policy tests now assert by-name varying locations.

## 2026-11-16 depth and pack textures (step 4)
- `LevelRendererIrisStateMixin` TAIL -> `CompositeRunner.captureWorldDepth()`: the finished world depth
  (translucents included) is copied into an R32F image, GL storage, before vanilla clears depth for the
  hand. depthtex0/1/2 all read this one copy (no separate pre-translucent / pre-hand copies yet). A
  non-sampleable depth format (combined depth/stencil) keeps depth white and logs once.
- `PackTextures`: noisetex (pack PNG or Iris's generated noise at the pack's resolution), PNG custom
  textures (blur/clamp) and resource-location textures become Minecraft textures, which VulkanMod already
  backs with Vulkan images. Raw/lightmap custom textures stay white (logged once). Freed on pack change.
- Not done: mipmapped targets (every target is single-level), shadow samplers (white until step 6).
  Iris's blit/copy needs are covered by the chain's own copy draws.

## 2026-11-16 union block reflects by name (step 3c)
- `translation/SpirvReflector`: an anonymous uniform block (the translator's `VulkairisUniformBlock {...};`)
  reflected with an empty name, and the dense binding remap had already moved it off raw binding 100, so
  `buildDescriptorConfig` found no block for the descriptor and every Iris post program failed to link
  ("Descriptor 'VulkairisUniformBlock' (binding 0, raw 100) has no reflected block", probe run 44008144043).
  Anonymous blocks now reflect under their block type name; member names are unchanged.
  Test: `origin/UnionBlockReflectionTest`.

## 2026-11-16 multi-target passes and depth/stencil depth (step 4b)
- `bridge/VulkanModProgramBridge`: one-output variants of a multi-target pass are built from the sources
  the program was linked with. Iris deletes a program's shaders right after linking, so the variant
  build found none ("vert is null", 141 retries in probe run 44010406762) and MakeUp's composite never
  wrote colortex6; final.vsh reads its exposure from there, so the whole frame was multiplied by 0.
  Failed variants are no longer retried every frame.
- `origin/composite/CompositeRunner`: a combined depth/stencil attachment (lavapipe picks
  D24_UNORM_S8_UINT) is sampled through its own DEPTH-only image view, so depthtex works there too.

## 2026-11-17 kept buffers (step 4c)
- `origin/composite/CompositeRunner`: honours the pack's `colortexNClear` / `colortexNClearColor`
  directives and, like Iris at frame end, copies a kept buffer whose newest content is on the ALT side
  back to MAIN. MakeUp keeps its auto-exposure in gaux3 (colortex6, `gaux3Clear = false`) and final.vsh
  multiplies the frame by it; clearing it every frame made the frame near-black (probe 44034547797 plan:
  composite writes colortex6 ALT, final reads ALT, the next frame read a cleared MAIN).
- `origin/composite/CompositeProbe` (CI only, `-Dvulkairis.composite.probe=true`): one readback of
  every post buffer, logged, to pin a wrong frame to one pass.

### 2026-11-17 fragment outputs keep their draw buffer (step 4d)
- `translation/ProgramTranslator`: the union pass stripped every `layout(location = N)` and renumbered
  fragment outs densely by declaration order. Iris declares `iris_FragDataN` in reverse order in some
  programs, so `iris_FragData2` landed at location 0 (SPIR-V cache of probe 44036544134), and MakeUp's
  composite wrote its exposure into colortex0 and 0 into colortex6: a black frame. An out now keeps its
  own explicit location (read before the strip), else the `iris_FragDataN` / `vulkairisFragDataN` suffix;
  only the rest are numbered densely.
- `translation/ShaderTranslator.injectLayoutLocations`: the same suffix rule for sources that reach the
  bridge without locations. Test: `FragDataLocationTest`.
- `origin/composite/CompositeRunner.sampleableDepth`: the depth-only view cache is keyed on the depth
  wrapper object as well as the VkImage handle; lavapipe handles are host pointers that a resized depth
  image can reuse, which would hand out a view of freed memory.

### 2026-11-17 nothing claims the sodium id (step 4e)
- `sodium-provider/` is removed. With a mod providing `sodium`, `isModLoaded("sodium")` was true under
  VulkanMod (probe 44041686578: "Sodium: true"), and Flywheel (Create) then loads its Sodium compat
  classes, which the stand-in does not have. Iris's `sodium 0.8.x` dependency is now removed at the
  loader level instead: the launcher writes `config/fabric_loader_dependencies.json` in each Vulkan
  account's game folder (`{"version":1,"overrides":{"iris":{"-depends":{"sodium":"*"}}}}`, Fabric
  Loader's dependency override file; same file at `tools/vulkan-probe/fabric_loader_dependencies.json`).
  `sodium-compat` (Origin's own stand-in types) stays nested and claims no id.

### 2026-11-17 pack gbuffers on VulkanMod terrain (step 5)
- `framebuffer/VulkanImageResource` + `backend/vulkanmod/VulkanBackendAdapter.allocateAndBindImageMemory`:
  upstream created pack render-target images with no memory bound; on AMD (amdvlk64) MakeUp's pack load
  crashed in vkCreateImageView (EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION). Images now get device-local memory before
  any view; `findMemoryType` no longer leaks its malloc.
- `translation/ShaderTranslator.declareFogFragCoordRaw` / `ProgramTranslator.declareFogFragCoord`:
  `gl_FogFragCoord` becomes a declared `vulkairis_FogFragCoord` varying (core GLSL has no such built-in).
- `origin/terrain/TerrainVertexAdapter` (+ test): rewrites a pack terrain vertex shader to read
  VulkanMod's packed chunk vertex (`ivec4 Position` / `uvec2 UV0` / `uint PackedColor`, ModelOffset
  push constant). Normal is a constant up vector and `mc_Entity` is -1 (VulkanMod carries neither).
- `origin/terrain/TerrainDraw`, `bridge/VulkanModTerrainHook`, `client/mixin/vulkan/VTextureSelectorMixin`:
  VulkanMod's terrain getter returns the pack's gbuffers_terrain / _cutout / gbuffers_water pipeline,
  with Iris uniforms and the camera matrices uploaded per bind and samplers rebound by name.
- Not yet through the pack: entities, block entities, hand (Iris's ExtendedShader path).

### 2026-11-17 shadow pass (step 6)
- Iris's ShadowRenderer never runs under VulkanMod. `origin/shadow/ShadowPass` (+ mixin
  `client/mixin/vulkan/WorldRendererShadowMixin` on `WorldRenderer.renderSectionLayer`) draws the
  opaque terrain layers again with the pack's `shadow` program before the solid layer, using Iris's own
  `createShadowModelView` / `ShadowMatrices` math, into `origin/shadow/ShadowMap` (D32F depth + RGBA8
  colour, pack resolution). `IrisUniformValues.lookup` serves shadowModelView/Projection(+Inverse).
- `sampler2DShadow` samplers (`ShadowSamplers`, + test) get a compare-enabled sampler; plain
  `sampler2D` reads get the plain one. Binding a non-depth placeholder to a `sampler2DShadow` read as
  "all shadowed" on AMD, which made pack terrain dark.
- Limits: casters are the sections VulkanMod culled for the camera view; no entity or translucent
  casters; shadowtex1 = shadowtex0.

### 2026-11-17 MakeUp on a real GPU (step 7)
Found on Will's RX 9070 XT with MakeUp (link FAILs, flat/near-black terrain, white hand, log flood).
- `translation/UnifiedTranslationService`: outcomes were cached by program name + generation only. The
  pack loads three times per run; the third load reused a stale outcome while its new shader ids stayed
  untranslated ("VulkairisUniformBlock has no reflected block" -> shadow / gbuffers_terrain /
  gbuffers_water "Program linking: FAIL"). The key now includes the attached shader ids;
  `bridge/VulkanModProgramBridge.resolveDriverSources` always translates by those ids.
- `origin/uniforms/IrisUniformValues.ensureBlockStateIds`: pack custom uniforms threw an NPE every
  frame because `WorldRenderingSettings.getBlockStateIds()` is filled by Iris's own
  `beginLevelRendering`, which never runs here. Every custom uniform (MakeUp's dayMixer, nightMixer...)
  stayed 0 and the world drew near-black. The id map is now built from the pack's IdMap first.
- `origin/terrain/TerrainFragmentAdapter` (+ test): Iris appends "alpha > 0.1" to cutout terrain
  (`AlphaTests.ONE_TENTH_ALPHA`); pack source has none, so grass and leaves drew as opaque squares.
  The translated fragment main is wrapped with the same test (not for gbuffers_water /
  shadow_translucent).
- `client/mixin/iris/ShaderMapMixin`: Iris's ExtendedShader replacements for vanilla core shaders do
  not compile into SPIR-V under VulkanMod (36 failures with MakeUp) and their uniforms have no supplier
  (the "not present in uniform map" flood); a failed one drew the hand white. Every entry is null, so
  entities, hand, particles, sky and text draw with VulkanMod's own shaders.
- `client/mixin/render/GameRendererCompositeMixin`: the composite/final chain now runs in
  `GameRenderer.renderLevel` before `popPush("hand")` (Iris's order), so the hand is drawn on top of the
  final image instead of being re-graded by it.
- `diagnostics/DebugLog`: the per-200-frame render-target lines, the loading-overlay and screen debug
  lines only log with `-Dvulkairis.debugLog=true`.
- Still open after step 7: entities/hand use vanilla shading rather than the pack's (normals, clouds and
  sky are step 8).

### 2026-11-17 terrain normals, pack clouds and sky haze (step 8)
- `origin/terrain/TerrainNormals` + `client/mixin/vulkan/CompressedVertexNormalMixin` (TAIL of
  `VertexBuilder$CompressedVertexBuilder.vertex(JFFFIFFII)V`): VulkanMod's 16-byte chunk vertex has no
  normal slot and drops the quad normal it is given. While a pack's gbuffers_terrain is linked, the quad
  normal is octahedral-encoded (4+4 bits) into the colour alpha byte; switching packs on/off rebuilds all
  chunks (`allChanged`). Block faces decode exactly, diagonal plant quads within ~10 degrees; 0xFF = up.
  Exact reconstruction was chosen over screen-space derivatives because MakeUp lights in the vertex shader.
- `origin/terrain/TerrainVertexAdapter`: decodes that byte into the pack's normal attribute and feeds
  colour alpha 1.0 (vanilla chunk alpha is always 1.0).
- `origin/composite/PackTextures.stageOverride` + `CompositeRunner`: per-stage custom textures
  (`texture.deferred.gaux2 = ...`) now replace the colortex for that stage, like Iris's sampler
  interceptor. MakeUp's volumetric clouds read their noise from deferred gaux2; it was colortex5 (no clouds).
- `origin/terrain/TerrainDraw.packTexture` + `CompositeRunner.lastFrameImage`: terrain colortex samplers
  read the post chain's last published image instead of white. MakeUp's prepare pass writes the sky
  gradient to gaux4, which terrain fog samples; white gave white haze. One frame late, since prepare runs
  in the post chain here.
- Still open: gbuffers-stage custom textures are not mapped; entities/hand keep vanilla shading; snow tops
  read slightly greyer than GL and the sun glow is weaker.

### 2026-11-17 pack programs for other mods' draws (step 9)
- `origin/api/ForeignPackPrograms` (new): a small reflection-friendly seam (JDK + VulkanMod types only,
  `API_VERSION = 1`) that hands another mod's draw (flywheel-vulkan's instanced Create/Trainworks meshes)
  the pack's final GLSL for a role (`block`: gbuffers_block, else gbuffers_terrain; `shadow`: shadow)
  with every descriptor in the caller's descriptor set, fills its uniform buffers and resolves its pack
  samplers. Shadow casters register a callback that runs inside the shadow pass. A program that can't be
  prepared returns null (logged once per pack) and never counts toward the link-failure breaker.
- `bridge/VulkanModProgramBridge.prepareForeign/writeForeignUniforms`: buildPipeline's translation up to
  the final GLSL (union bindings, varying locations, 0.1 alpha cutout) without touching the device.
- `origin/terrain/TerrainVertexAdapter.adaptForeign`: the same pack-attribute wrap, fed by the caller's
  `vulkairis_feed(...)` instead of VulkanMod's compressed chunk vertex. `origin/foreign/ForeignGlsl.moveToSet`
  moves descriptors into the caller's set.
- `iris/IrisBridge`: gbuffers_block is registered (not linked) for foreign draws; `origin/shadow/ShadowPass`
  calls the foreign casters with the shadow map bound (also when the pack has no terrain shadow program).
- `origin/terrain/TerrainDraw.matrixOverrides` (public, allocation-free) and `packImage`.
